description: This file defines a template class 'MessageDataBufferType' within the 'WPEFramework::Messaging' namespace. It manages inter-process communication buffers, including mechanisms for signaling via doorbells, reading/writing data, and handling metadata. The class encapsulates a nested 'DataBuffer' class that extends 'Core::CyclicBuffer' and provides methods for buffer management, synchronization, and signaling. It appears to be part of a messaging or IPC system, specifically for handling message buffers with associated metadata, and includes filename preparation for shared memory or socket-based communication.

classes.name: MessageDataBufferType
classes.description: A template class managing message data buffers with signaling and synchronization features, supporting inter-process communication with metadata handling.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: A nested class within 'MessageDataBufferType' that extends 'Core::CyclicBuffer' to provide buffer management, signaling via doorbells, and data size calculations.

methods.name: PrepareFilenames
methods.description: Static method to generate filenames for shared memory or socket communication based on directory, identifier, instance ID, and socket port.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the data file.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer and signals the other process via doorbell.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer after a doorbell ring, handling partial messages if necessary.

methods.name: Ring
methods.description: Signals that data is available by ringing the doorbell.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell signal within a specified timeout.

methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid.
